author: DeCombat
description: A weapon inspect for the G36E, the L96A1, the SCAR-L (MK16, Black, Trispear and Trispear LE) and the SCAR-H, and so for every camo of them: press the inspect key and the gun turns in the hands. It is drawn on your own screen only and changes nothing in play: no stats change, no reference gun applies, and firing, reloading or switching weapons cancels it at once.
name: Inspect: G36E, L96A1 and SCARs
